## 3.Scope of Work

The Scope of Works comprises the Construction of Parcel 11, Parcel 12 Townhomes & Grading Works for Parcel 11and remedying any defects therein as detailed in the ContractDocuments.

## 4. The Contract Sum

TheContractSum foranamountofEGP2.198.974.414(OnlyTwoBillionOne Hundred Ninety Eight Million Nine Hundred Seventy Four Thousand Four Hundred and Fourteen Egyptian Pounds) which is a fixed price lump sum,and the Works shall not be subject to re-measurement except the Earth Works (excavation,backfill and soil replacement) whichwill be subject to re-measurement / re-measured price,inaccordancewith theContractDocuments.The ContractSum is inclusive of all applicable taxes, insurance required under the Contract Documents, including but not limited to custom, duties, stamps, stamp duties, insurances, social insurances, VAT and any other costs or expenditures required in the Arab Republic of Egypt for proper completion of the Works, in addition to the Contractor's overhead and profit.

## The Contract Sum is based on the following:

- A.The unitrates andprices in theBillofQuantities shallbefixed and shall notbe subjecttoanyadjustmentinrespectofriseorfallinthecostoflabor,materials, Plant, Contractor's Equipment, transport or any other matters affecting the cost of execution of the Contract for any reason whatsoever except where the cost of executing theWorks orpart thereof is affected by thechangeof the announced rateofthehereunderlisteditems:
- ·DieselratewithItemBaseRateof15.50EGP/Lit
- ·Cement(Helwan) in Ready Mix Concrete with Item Base Rate of EGP 3.500 (+/5%)onthebasisofEx-FactoryandexcludingVAT
- Reinforcement steel rebars (Ezz) with Item Base Rate of EGP 33,500 (+/-5%) on the basis of Ex-Factory and excluding VAT
- 5%).

Materialsratesfor theseitemsareconsideredasmentionedinAnnex3tothe Form of Agreement, below or above which the agreed adjustment formula will be appliedforanychange inpricingfortheseItems.
